integrity: Analytical eight-state generator balance, covariance polynomial identities, Descartes root count and positivity arguments are given; a standard-library exact-arithmetic script reproduces symbolic and finite-state checks. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The exact two-threshold law is established for three lattice sites, unit forward rate, injection 1/2 and extraction 1/6. Nearby positive boundary rates retain at least two sign changes, not necessarily exactly two. No thermodynamic-limit assertion.
title: Reentrant distal occupation correlations in a three-site exclusion chain with local resetting
